name: MusicOrganizer
tagline: Audio tag editor & library organizer — auto-tag, dedupe and bulk rename.
description: Manage a music library: edit ID3/Vorbis/FLAC tags and album art, auto-tag from filenames or fill missing fields, find duplicate tracks, and bulk-rename/organize files by tag patterns (Artist/Album/Track). An open-source Mp3tag-style toolkit — works entirely offline.
